bands.label: Strong Match
bands.verdict: High alignment for the target role with bullet evidence, solid metrics, and evidenced must-haves.

bands.label: Partial Match
bands.verdict: Solid foundation meeting most core criteria; address minor evidence gaps or weak metrics to strengthen your review.

bands.label: Needs Work
bands.verdict: Notable gaps in must-have technologies, lack of metric depth, or ungrounded skill claims require targeted revision.

bands.label: Weak Match
bands.verdict: Substantial evidence gap against job description requirements due to missing core stack items or lack of project depth.
